title: Affine bijectivity criterion for a unit-normalized coefficient morphism
statement: Let f:X -> T be separated, F quasi-coherent on X, U an affine open of T and Z an affine open of f^{-1}U. Let g:T' -> U, g':X' -> X, f':X' -> T' form a cartesian square with f and g followed by U.ι. Put W=g'^{-1}((f^{-1}U).ι(Z)), M=g'^*F and let G and H be the coefficient functors defined in [def-pc-finite-affine-cech-model]. For any O_{T'}-linear morphism q:H(G(Z)) -> (W -> T')_*(M|W), suppose its global section map takes each canonical coefficient generator of s in F|f^{-1}U(Z) to eta_{g'}(s) restricted to W intersect f'^{-1}T'. The generators and support identification are the concrete ones in [lem-pc-finite-affine-cech-coefficient-comparison-map]. Then q is bijective on sections over every affine open B of T'. This assertion has one coefficient, assumes a given normalized map, and does not construct a map, assert face compatibility, or perform sheaf descent.

proof.text: Take the unit-compatible source and target tensor presentations over the affine open B, both with tensor module R tensor_A N.

Naturality of q under B -> top and the support identification transport the assumed normalization to equality on 1 tensor s. Compose the two restriction maps in the module presheaf to obtain the exact target generator formula.

R-linearity extends equality from 1 tensor s to r tensor s. Tensor induction extends it to every element. Thus q.app B is the composite of the source tensor equivalence and the inverse target tensor equivalence, so is bijective.

theorem coefficientComparison_affine_bijective {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T)
    [IsSeparated f] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : T.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (Z : (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) (hZ : IsAffineOpen Z)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι))
    (W : X'.Opens) (hW : W = g' ⁻¹ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ Z)) :
    let G := (F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).presheafModuleCat
    let H := ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)).inv ≫
        ((f ∣_ U) ≫ U.toScheme.toSpecΓ).appTop).hom) ⋙
      tilde.functor Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤) ⋙
      Modules.pullback U.toScheme.toSpecΓ ⋙ Modules.pullback g
    let M := (Modules.pullback g').obj F
    ∀ q : H.obj (G.obj (op Z)) ⟶
        (pushforward (W.ι ≫ f')).obj (M.restrict W.ι),
      (∀ s : Γ(F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι, Z),
        (coefficientSupportIso f' M W ⊤).hom
          (q.app ⊤ (coefficientGenerator g _ s)) =
        M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ ≤ W)).op
          (coefficientPullbackGenerator F (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) Z g' W hW s)) →
      ∀ B : T'.Opens, IsAffineOpen B → Function.Bijective (q.app B)
